name: spoko-portal-backend
description: Spoko Academy Portal REST API and Database Server

scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('db.json') || (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('db.json', 'utf8')||'{}').users?.length||0)===0) try { fs.copyFileSync('db.seed.json', 'db.json'); } catch(e){}"
